Author: welterusten
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#00ffff][b][i]﻿MinFizz Mineral Soda[/i][/b]
[size=4][b][i]the Soda with a *Crunch*[/i][/b]
VEGAN-FRIENDLY
ALL NATURAL
NON-TOXIC[/size][/color][color=#444444][size=1]*[/size][/color]
[color=#444444][size=1]in[/size][/color][color=#00ffff][size=4]ORGANIC
100% SAFE[/size][/color][color=#444444][size=1]**[/size][/color][/size][/center]
[color=#444444][size=1]*within reason
**under very hyper specific unreplicatable circumstances[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Adds a machine that allows for the processing of minerals with no extra fuel required. 
[*]Crafting recipe for said machine is unlocked from reaching Mining Level 8
[*]Adds a new Artisan Good of highly questionable nature
[*]Configurable themes between the default joke one and a less cluttered simple theme.
[*]Ability to configure the price increase of the resulting Artisan Good [s]because idk how to balance[/s] to suit your own personal taste buds
[*]Copy color from the input item if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22256]Extra Machine Configs[/url]﻿
[/list]
[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Download and install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*]Download this mod and unzip the contents into your [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Install_mods][i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i][/url]﻿ folder
[/list]
[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Tested on Single Player Stardew Valley 1.6 on Linux.
Compatible with any mod adding custom minerals and/ or gems provided that they have the category_minerals or category_gem context tag.
